description: This file defines the 'ProviderRole' class, an entity representing roles assigned to providers within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes annotations for database persistence, inheritance strategy, and auditing, along with getter/setter methods and a custom toString implementation.

classes.name: ProviderRole
classes.description: Entity class representing a provider's role in the OpenMRS system, with fields for ID and role name, including persistence and inheritance configurations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the provider role ID, overrides the method from superclass.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the provider role ID, overrides the method from superclass.

methods.name: getProviderRoleId
methods.description: Returns the provider role's unique identifier.

methods.name: setProviderRoleId
methods.description: Sets the provider role's unique identifier.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the ProviderRole object, including its ID and name.
